in_greek.name: Λορέντιος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Lorens' or 'Lorentios' is derived from the Latin name 'Loren' and means 'man from Loron'. In Greek mythology, Loron was a river god and the name may have been derived from this source.

in_latin.name: Loren
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Loren' is derived from the word 'laurus' meaning 'laurel'. In Roman mythology, the laurel tree was a symbol of victory and triumph. The name 'Loren' may have been given to those who were victorious in battle or were renowned in some way.
